references.text: Prohibition against sexual immorality called an 'abomination' to the Lord, using the same terminology as for an unclean offering
Prohibition against defiling one's daughter through prostitution, related to the prohibition against wages of a prostitute
Prophetic condemnation of prostitution and wages of a prostitute in Israel, using similar language about hire of a harlot
Micah mentions that wages of a prostitute will return to become wages of a prostitute, the same theme regarding unclean income
The offering of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, the same principle that unclean gifts are not accepted
Prohibition against bringing anything abominable into your house, the same theme concerning things that are an abomination to the Lord
Prohibition against sacrificing animals with defects because it is an abomination to the Lord, the same principle regarding unacceptable offerings
